fields.Name: C1 -> S2.6
fields.Description: Gate G2.25 (phase 2, dataset C1, criterion S2.6): in new-entity mode 0 member keys are shared between training and holdout (the reference: sharedKeys=0 on 2,268 / 367 rows), and 0 between inner-CV folds. The C1 protocol holds out the newest 15% of members whole from 2024-01-01 with no holdout end, so the stored manifest holds every carved row; the shared keys are measured from the manifest's PersonID group keys and the run's report must equal that partition (the reference holds out a seeded 30% of members instead, so its row counts differ). It fails when new-entity mode carves rows instead of entities (shared member keys > 0).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 0 member keys shared between training and the new-entity holdout, the report equal to the manifest's partition, and 0 across inner folds (2 of 2 pytest cases).
